select "id" from "projects" where ("projects"."company_id" = $1 and "projects"."id" = $2 and (
    with recursive privacy_nodes(kind,id) as (
      select $3::text,"projects"."id"
      union
      select edge.kind,edge.id from privacy_nodes n cross join lateral (select * from (        select 'issue'::text as kind,i.privacy_parent_issue_id as id from issues i
          where n.kind='issue' and i.id=n.id and i.company_id="projects"."company_id" and i.privacy_parent_issue_id is not null
        union all select 'issue',i.privacy_root_issue_id from issues i
          where n.kind='issue' and i.id
